panels.gesture: Genuine warm laughter, eyes narrowed pleasantly, mouth naturally open; one hand resting at the lower ribs and the other hand loosely opened outward. No wild caricature.
A knowing asymmetric smile and arched brow, eyes glancing sideways; one index finger lightly lifted near the chest as if making a playful observation, other hand at the waist.
Eyes widened and mouth slightly open, raised brows; both empty hands spontaneously lifted near the chest with relaxed spread fingers, no exaggerated scream.
Brows raised at the center and drawn together, eyes worried, speaking lips; one hand reaching toward the unseen listener with a gentle upturned palm, other touching own chest.

Firm direct gaze, knitted brows and a tense speaking mouth; one forearm makes a compact emphatic downward gesture with a loosely closed hand, opposite hand open low. Controlled civilian anger, no fighting pose.
Steady confident direct gaze and resolute mouth, shoulders straight; one closed hand held over the upper chest as a clear promise, other arm relaxed, no weapons.
A shy awkward small smile and eyes glancing downward, faint natural blush; one hand rubbing the back or side of the neck, the other fingers loosely clasping its own wrist low in frame.
Eyes lowered, brows drawn at the center, mouth gently compressed; one hand holding the opposite forearm across the lower torso, shoulders slightly softened, no crying caricature.
Reassuring gentle smile with calm eye contact; both open palms lowered and angled toward the ground in a soft calming gesture, slightly inclined toward the unseen person.
